author: Mark Atwood
text:
Already fixed, verified against current code. sct_extensions_len uses u16::try_from(...).map_err(|_| Error::SctExtensionsTooLong) -- the debug_assert the bead describes is gone and the variant exists.

The four remaining 'as u16' casts in the build_* functions are correct and not the bug: they write the LOW 16 BITS of a u24 length prefix whose high byte is pushed separately as ((len >> 16) & 0xFF), and the length is bounded above by a MAX_ASN1_CERT_LEN check that returns CertDerTooLong. Named that constant in this pass; it was the same magic number in six places.
